units.rawText: I didn't know your shrine was in the middle of the city, Luka-kun. That is truly amazing.

units.rawText: No, no... My father is the one who manages the shrine. Usually, all I do is assist him here and there.

units.rawText: It's similar to your work. Strictly speaking, however, there are differences between people seeking forgiveness and people seeking protection.
